name: DS18B20
description: Maxim DS18B20 — digital 1-Wire temperature sensor, addressable. Multiple sensors can share one GPIO.

pins.name: DQ
pins.notes: 1-Wire data line. Requires 4.7kΩ pull-up resistor to VCC.

notes: Requires a 4.7kΩ pull-up resistor between DQ and VCC — the ESP32 internal pull-up is too weak for reliable 1-Wire communication. The DallasTemperature library wraps OneWire for convenience; both must be in lib_deps. Temperature conversion at 12-bit resolution takes up to 750 ms — do not use delay(); use non-blocking requestTemperatures() + isConversionComplete().
